افتعلتن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلْتُنَّ (iftaʕaltunna) /if.ta.ʕal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلْتُنَّ (uftuʕiltunna) /uf.tu.ʕil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
